diagnosis.hypothesis: All failing ping pairs involved web1 (10.10.40.10) on fw-ext's eth2; the DMZ zone only listed eth3, so eth2 traffic was not subject to DMZ zone policies and was dropped. Added `set firewall zone DMZ interface eth2` on fw-ext (txn ani_tx_6c7ec969784582bd). Validation now shows all 10 endpoint pairs passing with 0% loss, and previously healthy paths (user1↔app1, finance1↔app1) remain up; no firewall rules were altered, so segmentation elsewhere is preserved.
diagnosis.reference: On the firewall fw-ext, interface eth2 was removed from zone DMZ, so traffic from DMZ to OUTSIDE is no longer matched by ruleset DMZ-TO-OUTSIDE and is dropped.

arguments.name: DMZ
arguments.reason: Failing paths all involve web1 (10.10.40.10) on eth2; DMZ zone only lists eth3, so eth2 traffic falls into the local zone and is dropped while DMZ->DMZ/DMZ->OUTSIDE policies never apply.

action.command: set firewall zone DMZ interface eth2
action.reason: Failing paths all involve web1 (10.10.40.10) on eth2; DMZ zone only lists eth3, so eth2 traffic falls into the local zone and is dropped while DMZ->DMZ/DMZ->OUTSIDE policies never apply.
